text: Man, Willy Adames needs to work on his baserunning. He runs into way too many outs.

Schmitt continues his early season tear, McDonald is 3-0 in his three starts, despite not being a regular in this rotation; both guys doing a hell of a job to keep this team still with a shot to get back to .500 by the break. Arraez has also been good, but without Schmitt's bat and McDonald winning every spot start lately, this team would be 13 or more below, instead of the 8 they are now. Still not great, but at least you're still within much closer striking distance to .500
